strongest_angle: An analysis comparing the stated canonical feats and attributes of Sherlock Holmes and Count Dracula, contrasting human logic with supernatural vampire abilities.

key_facts.fact: Count Dracula is explicitly described in Bram Stoker's novel as possessing the physical strength of twenty men.
Loren D. Estleman originally published the pastiche novel Sherlock Holmes vs. Dracula in 1978.
Dracula inhabits a crumbling castle located in the Carpathian Mountains.
Abraham Van Helsing describes Count Dracula as a former necromancer whose family had a long history of dealing with the devil.
